headline: Executive order directs further cuts to the size of the federal government, building on earlier reduction efforts.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order continues earlier efforts to shrink the federal workforce and federal agencies. No official summary was provided, so the specific agencies, programs, or steps it covers cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.how: Workers at affected agencies could face job cuts or changes to their offices.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations that use services from affected agencies
who_it_affects.how: Services or programs could be reduced if the agencies that run them are cut back.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 14, 2025; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
